summary.text: Dan Dernulc is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate for District 1, elected in 2022.
The caucus page lists his service on the Environmental Affairs, Local Government, Pensions and Labor, and Public Policy committees.

paragraphs.text: Dernulc holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering technology from Purdue University Northwest and is a retired project manager in corporate security at AT&T.
The page says he represents a portion of Lake County and lives in Highland, where he and his wife raised four children.
